title: Augusta Canal National Heritage Area
specs: Only industrial power canal still in use for its original purpose.
Wide, level towpath once used by mules to pull canal boats.
Urban wildlife refuge with diverse animals including deer, fox, beavers, alligators, and more.

blurb: Visitors can hike or bike on the towpath along the historic canal, paddle a canoe or kayak, fish from the canal banks, or take guided boat tours aboard a replica canal cargo boat. The canal area includes natural and urban landscapes with wildlife viewing opportunities. The Augusta Canal Discovery Center offers historical exhibits about the canal's construction and use.
